# scripts/Night/Rain.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Night/Rain.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Camera-following rain streaks and splashes, driven by amount [0,1] and wind in m/s.
A camera-following heightfield stops drops at roofs/overhangs; periodic rays report camera shelter.

Base: `Node3D`. Registered class: `none`.
